searchText: There is a web page that tracks the status of isogeny based crypto: https://issikebrokenyet.github.io/ csidh was done by one of the folks that broke SIKE and SIDH btw Given that lattices are homomorphic, I would expect it should be possible to create an aggregation scheme using lattices Here is one based on lattices: https://eprint.iacr.org/2022/1036 aggregation is a linear combination there is also this for isogenies but can't access it: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-99-7032-2_28
